name: Branislav Ivanović
bio:
Branislav's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the digital realm. A keen programmer in his youth, he developed simulations for racing teams, optimizing pit stop strategies and fuel consumption. His sharp analytical mind and ability to predict outcomes caught the attention of a smaller rally team, where he honed his skills in real-world scenarios. 

After several successful seasons improving race outcomes, Branislav joined Toyota Gazoo Racing, bringing his data-driven approach to the highest echelons of the sport. He prides himself on his adaptability, adjusting strategies on the fly to account for changing track conditions and competitor moves. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and clear communication, even under intense pressure. Branislav is particularly known for his ability to identify and exploit subtle advantages that others might overlook, often leading to decisive gains.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Branislav is of medium height, with a slightly stocky build that suggests a love for good food.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn track maps and calculations.
Has a habit of clicking his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking strong Serbian coffee before every race.
